thread:
Lina (Partnerships): Heads-up: RaptorEdge's private offer is failing the marketplace PO submission — portal returns a currency/sku validation error. Were blocked on the deal desk flow for a big APAC reseller.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Ugh. Any error details? Screenshot?
Lina (Partnerships): Portal error: `400: PO_INVALID: currency_mismatch (offer_currency=USD, po_currency=EUR) and sku_not_found: seller_sku=RE-ULTRA-1` — attached log from portal.
RaptorEdge Sales: We're listing prices in USD on the marketplace but our distributor in EU submitted the PO in EUR. They also use a region-specific SKU `RE-ULTRA-1-EU`. We expected the marketplace to accept currency conversion.
Priya (Finance): Marketplace doesn't auto-convert; PRICING must match offer currency or marketplace conversion flags must be set. Two options: 1) ask distributor to resubmit in USD, 2) create an alias SKU mapping on our seller account that maps `RE-ULTRA-1-EU` -> `RE-ULTRA-1` and enable EUR price on the offer (requires seller action). Need impact to revenue recognition and VAT.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Distributor won't resubmit — they have an automated flow. Can we do a temporary SKU alias + currency flag? How fast?
Jordan (Legal): Any aliasing or silent conversion needs to be recorded. If we accept EUR and convert, we must document FX rate used and who bears FX risk. Also check reseller agreement for currency clauses.
procurement-bot: Task created: PR-2233 "RaptorEdge marketplace PO currency/sku acceptance exception" assigned to Ethan. Due: 2026-04-02.
marketplace-bot: Portal note: "Seller-level SKU alias creation requires seller portal approval and 24-48h propagation."
Priya (Finance): If we accept a converted EUR PO, accounting needs gross/functional currency mapping. We can accept temporarily but must store conversion rate as settlement metadata. We should also log a manual reconciliation line in the marketplace payout feed.
Lina (Partnerships): Proposed short-term plan: request RaptorEdge to add SKU alias + enable EUR pricing for the private offer, legal sign off on FX handling, and deal desk to approve a one-off override to accept incoming EUR PO so it doesn't bounce. Medium-term: require sellers to list regional SKUs or enable marketplace conversion in the onboarding checklist.
Ethan (Deal Desk): I'll call RaptorEdge now. If they can create alias within 24h we can do a controlled accept. Otherwise we'll have to pause order routing.
RaptorEdge Sales: On it. We can add alias today but need Redwood to accept a temporary FX handling note (we'll sign). ETA 6-8 hours.
Jordan (Legal): I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum that clarifies FX treatment for this PO and the alias behavior. Quick review within 24h.
Priya (Finance): After alias + addendum, finance will run a simulated payout for the PO to confirm settlement fields. Please route a test PO to staging.
Ethan (Deal Desk): @marketplace-bot can you create a staging PO with EUR currency and seller_sku=RE-ULTRA-1-EU for testing?
marketplace-bot: Staging PO created: staging-po-90123. Use `staging.payouts/test-queue` for settlement simulation.
Lina (Partnerships): Great. Keep thread posted. If RaptorEdge can't add alias within 24h, we escalate to VP Partnerships. This is time-sensitive for the reseller promo window.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Noted. I'll escalate if no alias confirmation in 12h.
Lina (Partnerships): Also capture the edge-case in our marketplace onboarding checklist: regional SKUs + currency flags.
